title: Wither main-head friends-only
description: An unprovoked Wither pursues a visible eligible target, excluding undead friends and respecting sight at acquisition.
notes: Run tick-frozen with a connected creative player in a fresh isolated arena. Main-head metadata DATA_TARGET_A (id16 on protocol777) must name the sheep for visible/friend-nearer cases and stay zero for friends-only/occluded cases. Verify pursuit in positive cases after exactly eight ticks; negative cases may still wander with no main-head target. The short window avoids sheep death. Does not assert attack timing or full fight parity.
